notes: Xinglongwa culture of the Liao River basin; the body says '6200-5400 BC' while the infobox says '6200 BC - 5000 BC'; 5400 is used because the successor Zhaobaogou begins there on its own page (5400-4500 BC) and the Hongshan page also gives 'Xinglongwa culture (6200-5400 BC)'; it began before the project's first year, so the dossier starts at -6000. Extent: 'found mainly around the Inner Mongolia- Liaoning border at the Liao River basin'; type site 'at Aohan Banner, Chifeng, Inner Mongolia', Xinglonggou 'the only site with evidence of agriculture'. No area, no site count. Two discs (Chifeng 100 km, Chaoyang 80 km) are drawn, confidence 2. Predecessor: the infobox names the Xiaohexi culture (undated on the page; before the floor; no dossier). Successor: the infobox names the Zhaobaogou; the Chaoyang part passes to nobody in 5400 (the Zhaobaogou page places its culture in the Luan valley and at Aohan only), confidence 1. The Xinle culture (Shenyang; the page gives no dates, only that a carving is 'some 7,200 years old') has no dossier. No area figure.
